lines.text: At night, not in the night!
Many learners say: I often study in the night.
Better: I often study at night.

data.wrong: I often study in the night.

native.tip: 中文说“在晚上”，很多人就直译成 in the night。英语里表示“晚上”通常说 at night。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I often study in the night.”😅 中文说“在晚上”，英语里“晚上”要说 at night：“I often study at night.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I often study at night.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: A word-for-word translation gives in the night, but English says at night.
en.caption: Do you say “I often study in the night.” 😅 Word for word gives in the night, but English says at night: “I often study at night.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
